skill_name: Investigate what options are available for testing GPT models.
workflow: There are several options available for testing GPT models. The most common approach is to create a dataset of test prompts and use it to evaluate the GPT model's response. Additionally, you can use automatic metrics such as BLEU, ROUGE, and METEOR scores to measure the quality of the output. Another method is to use human evaluations, where humans are asked to provide scores for the GPT model's outputs. Finally, you may be able to build your own testing environment by training a local GPT model
